items.title: Job scheduler poll interval
items.description: How often the job scheduler thread checks for jobs to run. Set to 0 to globally disable scheduled jobs.
items.notes: The interval of `php artisan kennword:schedule`; 0 disables the scheduler, also with `--once`, where cron sets the interval. Tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Send purge schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that checks for Sends past their deletion date. Defaults to hourly. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Trash purge schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that checks for trashed items to delete permanently. Defaults to daily. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Incomplete 2FA login schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that checks for incomplete 2FA logins. Defaults to once every minute. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Emergency notification reminder schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that sends expiration reminders to emergency access grantors. Defaults to hourly. (3 minutes after the hour) Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Emergency request timeout schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that grants emergency access requests that have met the required wait time. Defaults to hourly. (7 minutes after the hour) Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Event cleanup schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that cleans old events from the event table. Defaults to daily. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Auth Request cleanup schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that cleans old auth requests from the auth request. Defaults to every minute. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Duo Auth context cleanup schedule
items.description: Cron schedule of the job that cleans expired Duo contexts from the database. Does nothing if Duo MFA is disabled. Defaults to once every minute. Set blank to disable this job.
items.notes: Chooses and times its job like schedule_jobs (App\Scheduler\JobScheduler, App\Support\CronSchedule ports the cron crate); tested in tests/Feature/Scheduler/JobSchedulerTest.

items.title: Purge incomplete SSO auth.

items.description: Which addresses the client IP header is accepted from. Requests from any other address use the remote IP instead, so a client can't spoof the header. Either the string "local" (the default, any non-global address, which covers a reverse proxy running on the same host or container network), the string "all" to accept it from anywhere, or a comma separated list of IPs and CIDR ranges. For a list header like X-Forwarded-For, the client IP is the rightmost address that isn't a trusted proxy, so list every proxy in the chain.
